newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor markets closed for public holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor markets closed for public holiday.

text.p: Indian castorseed forward markets were closed on Friday to mark a Moslem festival, dealer said.
In unofficial kerb trade however, castorseed September delivery rose by 2/3 rupees at 1,154/1,155 rupees per quintal on continued speculative support, floor sources said.
"A srop in the arrivals and increased overseas enquiries triggered buoyancy in the castorseed market," one source said.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region fell to 4,000/5,000 bags (75 kg each) against 9,000/10,000 bags reported on Thursday.
Groundnut oil remained steady at 372/373 rupees per 10 kg on limited inflows of 40/50 tonnes while consumer buying remained low. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 580/585 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay, imported palm oil slid by 1/2 rupees at 259/260 rupees per 10 kg as losses in the world market prompted profit-taking by the local importers.
Sentiment was subdued as marketmen were expecting fresh arrivals of imported palm oil at the Bombay port next week.
